input.title: Money Laundering, Illegal Markets, Tax Evasion: Old Realities of New Economy
input.authors: Pirogova, T; Miguel, A; Kosihina, O
input.abstract: The modern new economy has globally stimulated the old monetary phenomenon-money laundering. The scale of illegal activities and shadow economy in Russia is alarming which actualizes the question of Central Bank anti-money laundering policy efficiency. Shadow institutions continue to change, new algorithms for legalizing dirty income continue to appear, which requires timely and adequate reactions from the part of the state.
input.source: UBIQUITOUS COMPUTING AND THE INTERNET OF THINGS: PREREQUISITES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ICT

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
